verses.text: “Di Levitical priests, even all di tribe of Levi, no go get portion nor inheritance with Israel. Dem go eat di offerings of di Lord made by fire, and im portion.
Dem go get no inheritance among dem brothers. Di Lord na dem inheritance, as e don speak to dem.
Dis go be di priests due from di people, from dem wey offer one sacrifice, whether na ox or sheep: dem go give to di priest di shoulder, and di two cheeks, and di stomach.
Di first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and di first of di fleece of your sheep, you go give am to am.
Because di Lord your God don choose am out of all your tribes, to stand to minister for di name of di Lord, am and im pikin man dem forever.
If one Levite come from any of your gates out of all Israel, wia e live, and come with all di desire of im soul to di place wey di Lord go choose,
e go minister for di name of di Lord im God, as all im brothers di Levites do, wey stand dere before di Lord.
Dem go eat equal portions, besides wetin e get from di sale of im inheritance.
When you don come into di land wey di Lord your God dey give you, you no go learn to do after di abominations of dem nations.
Dere no go dey found among una anyone wey make im pikin man or im pikin woman go through di fire, or wey use divination, or one soothsayer, or one enchanter, or one sorcerer,
or one charmer, or one wey consult familiar spirit, or one wizard, or one necromancer.
Because all wey do dem things na abomination to di Lord. Because of dem abominations di Lord your God dey drive dem out from before you.
You go dey blameless before di Lord your God.
Because dem nations, wey you go dispossess, listen to dem wey practice sorcery, and to diviners, but as for you, di Lord your God no allow you to do so.
Di Lord your God go raise up to you one prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me. Una go listen to am,

according to all wey you desire of di Lord your God for Horeb for di day of di assembly, talk, ‘Make I no hear again di voice of di Lord my God, neither make I see dis great fire any more, so that I no go die.’
Di Lord talk to me, ‘Dem don well say dat wey dem don speak.
I go raise dem up one prophet from among dem brothers, like you. I go put my words for im mouth, and e go speak to dem all wey I command am.
E go come be say, whoever no go listen to my words wey e go speak for my name, I go require am of am.
But di prophet, wey go speak one word presumptuously for my name, wey I no command am to speak, or wey go speak for di name of other gods, dat same prophet go die.’
If you talk for your heart, ‘How we go know di word wey di Lord no speak?’
When one prophet speak for di name of di Lord, if di thing no follow, nor come to pass, dat na di thing wey di Lord no speak. Di prophet don speak am presumptuously. You no go dey afraid of am.”
“When di Lord your God don cut off di nations, whose land di Lord your God dey give you, and you don dispossess dem, and dwell for dem cities, and for dem houses,
you go set apart three cities for yourself for di middle of your land, wey di Lord your God dey give you to possess am.
You go prepare di way, and divide di borders of your land, wey di Lord your God cause you to inherit, into three parts, so that every manslayer go flee dere.
Dis na di case of di manslayer, wey go flee dere and live: whoever kill im neighbour unintentionally, and no hate am in time past,

as when one man go into di forest with im neighbour to cut wood, and im hand fetch one stroke with di axe to cut down di tree, and di head slip from di handle, and strike im neighbour, so that e die, e go flee to one of dem cities, and live,

otherwise di avenger of blood go pursue di manslayer, while im heart dey hot, and overtake am, because di way dey long, and strike am mortally, whereas e no deserve death, because e no hate am in time past.
Therefore I command you, talk, ‘You go set apart three cities for yourself.’
If di Lord your God enlarge your border, as e don swear to your papa dem, and give you all di land wey e promise to give to your papa dem,
if you keep all dis commandment to do am, wey I command you today, to love di Lord your God, and to waka always for im ways, you go add three cities more for yourself, besides dem three.
So that innocent blood no go dey shed for di midst of your land, wey di Lord your God dey give you for inheritance, and so blood-guilt no go dey on you.
But if any man hate im neighbour, and lie in wait for am, and rise up against am, and strike am mortally so that e die, and e flee into one of dem cities,
di elders of im city go send and fetch am from dere, and deliver am into di hand of di avenger of blood, so that e die.
Your eye no go pity am, but you go put away di innocent blood from Israel, so that e go go well with you.
You no go remove your neighbour landmark, wey dem of old time don set, for your inheritance wey you go inherit, for di land wey di Lord your God dey give you to possess am.
One witness no go rise up against one man for any iniquity, or for any sin, for any sin wey e go sin. At di mouth of two witnesses, or at di mouth of three witnesses, di matter go dey established.
If one malicious witness rise up against any man to testify against am of wrongdoing,
di two men, between wey di controversy dey, go stand before di Lord, before di priests and di judges wey dey for dem days.
Di judges go make diligent enquiry. If di witness na one false witness, and don testify falsely against im brother,
you go do to am as e don purpose to do to im brother. So you go put away di evil from among una.
Dem wey remain go hear, and fear, and go henceforth commit no more any such evil among una.
Your eye no go pity: life go be for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.”

“When you go out to battle against your enemies, and see horses, and chariots, and one people more than you, you no go dey afraid of dem, because di Lord your God dey with you, wey bring you up out of di land of Egypt.
E go be say, when una draw near to di battle, di priest go approach and speak to di people,
and go talk to dem, ‘Hear, Israel, una dey draw near today to battle against una enemies. Make una heart no faint. No dey afraid, nor tremble, neither dey scared because of dem,
because di Lord una God na im dey go with una, to fight for una against una enemies, to save una.’

Di officers go speak to di people, talk, ‘Who be di man wey don build one new house, and no dedicate am? Make am go and return to im house, otherwise e go die for di battle, and another man go dedicate am.
Who be di man wey don plant one vineyard, and no yet use di fruit of am? Make am go and return to im house, otherwise e go die for di battle, and another man go use di fruit of am.
Who be di man wey don engage one wife, and no yet take am? Make am go and return to im house, otherwise e go die for di battle, and another man go take am.’
Di officers go speak further to di people, and go talk, ‘Who be di man wey dey afraid and fainthearted? Make am go and return to im house, so that im brothers heart no go melt as im heart.’
E go come be say, when di officers don finish speaking to di people, say dem go appoint captains of armies at di head of di people.
When you draw near to one city to fight against am, proclaim peace to am.
If e answer you peace, and open to you, all di people wey dey found inside am go become forced labourers to you, and go serve you.
If e no make peace with you, but make war against you, you go besiege am.
When di Lord your God deliver am into your hand, you go strike every male of am with di edge of di sword,

but di women, and di little ones, and di livestock, and all wey dey inside di city, even all im plunder, you go take for yourself as plunder. You go enjoy di plunder of your enemies, wey di Lord your God give you.
Na so you go do to all di cities wey dey very far from you, wey no be of di cities of dem nations.
But of di cities of dem peoples, wey di Lord your God dey give you for inheritance, you go save alive nothing wey breathe,
but you go utterly destroy dem: di Hittite, di Amorite, di Canaanite, di Perizzite, di Hivite, and di Jebusite, as di Lord your God don command you,
so that dem no go teach una to do after all dem abominations, wey dem don do for dem gods, so that una sin against di Lord una God.

When you go besiege one city one long time, in making war against am to take am, you no go destroy di trees of am by wielding one axe against dem, because you go eat of dem, and you no go cut dem down. Di tree of di field na man, say e go dey besieged by you?
Only di trees wey you know say dem no be trees for food, you go destroy and cut down, so that you go build bulwarks against di city wey make war with you, until e fall.”
“If one man dey found slain for di land wey di Lord your God dey give you to possess am, lying for di field, and e no dey known who strike am,
di elders and di judges go go out, and measure to di cities wey dey round about di slain one.
E go be say di city wey dey nearest to di slain man, di elders of dat city go take one heifer of di herd, wey no don dey worked with, and wey no don pull for yoke.
Di elders of dat city go bring down di heifer to one valley with running water, wey no dey ploughed nor sown, and go break di heifer neck dere for di valley.

Di priests di pikin man dem of Levi go come near, because di Lord your God don choose dem to minister to am, and to bless for di name of di Lord, and by dem word every controversy and every assault go dey decided.
All di elders of dat city, wey dey nearest to di slain man, go wash dem hands over di heifer wey dem break neck for di valley.
Dem go answer and talk, ‘Our hands no shed dis blood, neither our eyes see am.
Forgive, Lord, your people Israel, wey you don redeem, and no lay innocent blood for di midst of your people Israel.’ Di blood go dey forgiven dem.
So you go put away di innocent blood from among una, when you do wetin dey right for di eyes of di Lord.
When you go out to battle against your enemies, and di Lord your God deliver dem into your hands, and you carry dem away captive,
and see among di captives one beautiful woman, and you desire am, and take am to be your wife,
you go bring am home to your house. E go shave im head, and trim im nails.
E go take off di clothes of im captivity, and go remain for your house, and bewail im papa and im mama one full month. After dat you go go in to am, and be im husband, and e go be your wife.
E go be, if you no delight for am, say you go let am go wherever e want. But you no go sell am at all for money. You no go treat am as merchandise, because you don humble am.
If one man get two wives, one loved, and di other hated, and dem don born pikin for am, both di loved and di hated, and if di firstborn pikin man na di hated one own,
e go be, in di day wey e cause im pikin man dem to inherit wetin e get, say e no fit give di firstborn right to di pikin man of di loved before di pikin man of di hated, wey be di firstborn.
But e go acknowledge di firstborn, di pikin man of di hated, by giving am one double portion of all wey e get, because e na di beginning of im strength. Di right of di firstborn na im own.
If one man get one stubborn and rebellious pikin man, wey no go obey di voice of im papa, or di voice of im mama, and, though dem don chastise am, e no go listen to dem,
im papa and im mama go take hold of am, and bring am out to di elders of im city, and to di gate of im place.
Dem go talk to di elders of im city, ‘Dis pikin man of ours dey stubborn and rebellious. E no go obey our voice. E na glutton, and one drunkard.’
All di men of im city go stone am to death with stones. So you go put away di evil from among una. All Israel go hear, and fear.
If one man don commit one sin worthy of death, and e dey put to death, and you hang am on one tree,

im body no go remain all night for di tree, but you go surely bury am di same day, because im wey dey hanged na one curse of God. You no go defile di land wey di Lord your God dey give you for inheritance.”
“You no go see your brother ox or im sheep go astray, and hide yourself from dem. You go surely bring dem again to your brother.
If your brother no dey near you, or if you no know am, you go bring am home to your house, and e go dey with you until your brother seek am, and you go restore am to am.
You go do di same with im donkey. You go do di same with im garment. You go do di same with every lost thing of your brother, wey e don lose, and you don find. You no fit hide yourself.
You no go see your brother donkey or im ox fall down by di way, and hide yourself from dem. You go surely help am to lift dem up again.
One woman no go wear wetin pertain to one man, neither go one man put on one woman garment, because whoever do dem things na abomination to di Lord your God.

If one bird nest happen to dey before you for di way, for any tree or on di ground, with young ones or eggs, and di mother dey sitting on di young ones, or on di eggs, you no go take di mother with di young.
You go surely let di mother go, but di young you fit take for yourself, so that e go go well with you, and so that you go prolong your days.
When you build one new house, you go make one parapet for your roof, so that you no go bring blood-guilt on your house, if anyone fall from am.
You no go sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, otherwise di whole fruit go dey forfeited, di seed wey you don sow, and di increase of di vineyard.
You no go plough with one ox and one donkey together.
You no go wear one garment of different sorts, as of wool and linen together.
You go make yourself tassels on di four corners of your cloak, wey you cover yourself with.
If any man take one wife, and go in to am, and hate am,
and accuse am of shameful things, and bring one bad name on am, and talk, ‘I take dis woman, and when I come near to am, I no find for am di tokens of virginity,’
di papa of di young woman and im mama go take and bring forth di tokens of di young woman virginity to di elders of di city for di gate.
Di young woman papa go talk to di elders, ‘I give my pikin woman to dis man as wife, and e hate am.

Look, e don accuse am of shameful things, say e no find for my pikin woman di tokens of virginity. But dem na di tokens of my pikin woman virginity.’ Dem go spread di cloth before di elders of di city.
Di elders of dat city go take di man and chastise am.
Dem go fine am 100 shekels of silver, and give dem to di papa of di young woman, because e don bring one bad name upon one virgin of Israel. E go remain im wife. E no fit divorce am all im days.
But if dis thing dey true, say di tokens of virginity no dey found for di young woman,

dem go bring out di young woman to di door of im papa house, and di men of im city go stone di young woman to death with stones, because e don commit folly for Israel, to play di prostitute for im papa house. So you go put away di evil from among una.
If one man dey found lying with one woman wey dey married to one husband, dem two go die, di man wey lie with di woman, and di woman. So you go put away di evil from Israel.
If dere dey one young woman wey be virgin engaged to one husband, and one man find am for di city, and lie with am,

una go bring dem two out to di gate of dat city, and una go stone dem to death with stones, di young woman, because e no cry for help, though e dey for di city, and di man, because e don humble im neighbour wife. So you go put away di evil from among una.
But if di man find di young woman wey dey engaged for di field, and di man force am, and lie with am, di man wey lie with am only go die.
But to di young woman you go do nothing. Di young woman no get sin worthy of death, because as when one man rise up against im neighbour, and kill am, even so na dis matter.
Because e find am for di field. Di young woman wey dey engaged cry, but no one dey to save am.
If one man find one young woman wey be virgin, wey no dey engaged, and lay hold on am, and lie with am, and dem find dem,
di man wey lie with am go give to di young woman papa 50 shekels of silver, and di young woman go be im wife, because e don humble am. E no fit divorce am all im days.
One man no go take im papa wife, and no go uncover im papa skirt.”
“One wey dem don crush or cut im private parts no go enter into di assembly of di Lord.
One wey dem born from forbidden marriage no go enter into di assembly of di Lord. Even to di tenth generation none of im descendants go enter into di assembly of di Lord.
One Ammonite or Moabite no go enter into di assembly of di Lord. Even to di tenth generation none of dem go enter into di assembly of di Lord forever,
because dem no meet una with bread and with water for di way, when una come out of Egypt, and because dem hire against you Balaam di pikin of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.
Nevertheless di Lord your God no listen to Balaam, but di Lord your God turn di curse into one blessing to you, because di Lord your God love you.
You no go seek dem peace nor dem prosperity all your days forever.
You no go abhor one Edomite, because e na your brother. You no go abhor one Egyptian, because you dey one stranger for im land.
Di pikin dem of di third generation wey dem born to dem go enter into di assembly of di Lord.
When you go out in di camp against your enemies, you go keep yourself from every evil thing.
If dere dey among una any man wey no dey clean by reason of wetin happen to am for night, e go go outside di camp. E no go come inside di camp,
but e go come be say, when evening come, e go bathe imself in water, and when di sun don go down, e go come inside di camp.
You go get one place also outside di camp, wia you go go out.
You go get one paddle among your weapons. When you sit down outside, you go dig am with am, and turn back and cover wetin come from you,

because di Lord your God waka for di middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp go dey holy, so that e no go see any unclean thing for you, and turn away from you.
You no go deliver to im master one servant wey don escape from im master to you.
E go dwell with you, among una, for di place wey e go choose within one of your gates, wherever e like. You no go oppress am.
Dere no go be any woman temple prostitute among di pikin woman dem of Israel, neither go dere be any man temple prostitute among di pikin man dem of Israel.
You no go bring di wages of one prostitute, or di price of one dog, into di house of di Lord your God for any vow, because even both of dem na abomination to di Lord your God.
You no go lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything wey dem fit lend for interest.

To one foreigner you fit lend on interest, but to your brother you no go lend on interest, so that di Lord your God go bless you for all wey you put your hand to, for di land wia you dey go in to possess am.
When you vow one vow to di Lord your God, you no go be slack to pay am, because di Lord your God go surely require am of you, and e go be sin to you.
But if you refrain from vowing, e no go be sin to you.
Wetin don go out of your lips you go keep and do, according as you don vow to di Lord your God, wetin you don promise with your mouth as one free will offering.
When you come into your neighbour vineyard, you fit eat grapes your fill at your own pleasure, but you no go put any for your container.
When you come into your neighbour standing grain, you fit pluck di ears with your hand, but you no go use sickle to cut di neighbour standing grain.”

“When one man take one wife, and marry am, and e go be, if e find no favour for im eyes, because e don find some unseemly thing for am, say e go write am one certificate of divorce, and put am for im hand, and send am out of im house.
When di woman don depart out of im house, di woman go go and become another man wife.
If di latter husband hate am, and write am one certificate of divorce, and put am for im hand, and send am out of im house, or if di latter husband die, wey take am to be im wife,

im former husband, wey send am away, no go take am again to be im wife, after dat e don dey defiled, because dat na abomination before di Lord. You no go cause di land to sin, wey di Lord your God dey give you for inheritance.
When one man don newly take one wife, e no go go out in di army, neither go dem charge am with any business. E go dey free at home one year, and go cheer im wife wey e don take.
No man go take di mill or di upper millstone to pledge, because e dey take man life to pledge.
If one man dey found stealing any of im brothers of di pikin dem of Israel, and e treat am as merchandise, or sell am, dat thief go die. So you go put away di evil from among una.
Take heed for di plague of leprosy, say you observe diligently, and do according to all wey di Levitical priests go teach una. As I command dem, so una go observe to do.
Remember wetin di Lord your God do to Miriam for di way, when una come out of Egypt.
When you lend to your neighbour any kind of loan, you no go go into im house to fetch im pledge.
You go stand outside, and di man to whom you lend go bring out di pledge outside to you.
If e dey one poor man, you no go sleep with im pledge.
You go surely restore to am di pledge when di sun go down, so that e go sleep in im cloak, and bless you. E go be righteousness to you before di Lord your God.
You no go oppress one hired servant wey dey poor and needy, whether na of your brothers or of your strangers wey dey inside your gates.
You go give am im wages for im day, neither go di sun go down on am, because e dey poor, and e set im heart on am, so that e no go cry against you to di Lord, and e go be sin to you.
Di papa dem no go dey put to death for di pikin dem, neither go di pikin dem dey put to death for di papa dem. Every man go dey put to death for im own sin.
You no go pervert di justice due to di stranger or to di orphan, nor take di widow clothing as pledge.
But you go remember say you dey one servant for Egypt, and di Lord your God redeem you from dere. Therefore I command you to do dis thing.

When you reap your harvest for your field, and don forget one sheaf for di field, you no go go again to fetch am. E go be for di stranger, for di orphan, and for di widow, so that di Lord your God go bless you for all di work of your hands.
When you beat your olive tree, you no go go over di boughs again. E go be for di stranger, for di orphan, and for di widow.
When you gather di grapes of your vineyard, you no go glean am after you. E go be for di stranger, for di orphan, and for di widow.
You go remember say you dey one servant for di land of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do dis thing.”
“If dere dey one controversy between men, and dem come to judgment, and di judges judge dem, dem go justify di righteous, and condemn di wicked.
E go be, if di wicked man dey worthy to dey beaten, di judge go cause am to lie down, and to dey beaten before im face, according to im fault, by number.
E fit give am 40 stripes, e no go exceed, so that if e go exceed, and beat am above dem with many stripes, your brother go dey dishonoured before your eyes.
You no go muzzle di ox when e dey tread out di grain.

If brothers dwell together, and one of dem die, and get no pikin man, di dead man wife no go marry outside to one stranger. Im husband brother go go in to am, and take am to im as wife, and perform di duty of husband brother to am.
E go be say di firstborn wey e bear go succeed to di name of im brother wey dey dead, so that im name no go dey blotted out of Israel.

If di man no want to take im brother wife, im brother wife go go up to di gate to di elders, and talk, ‘My husband brother refuse to raise up to im brother one name for Israel. E no go perform di duty of husband brother to me.’
Di elders of im city go call am, and speak to am. If e stand, and talk, ‘I no want to take am,’

im brother wife go come near to am for di sight of di elders, and loose im sandal from off im foot, and spit for im face. Di woman go answer and talk, ‘So e go dey done to di man wey no build up im brother house.’
Im name go dey called for Israel, ‘Di house of am wey im sandal dem loose.’
When men strive together one with another, and di wife of one draw near to deliver di husband out of di hand of am wey strike am, and put out im hand, and seize am by im private parts,
you go cut off di woman hand. Your eye no go pity am.
You no go get for your bag different kinds of weights, one great and one small.
You no go get for your house different kinds of measures, one great and one small.
You go get one perfect and just weight. You go get one perfect and just measure, so that your days go dey long for di land wey di Lord your God dey give you.
Because all wey do such things, all wey do unrighteously, na abomination to di Lord your God.
Remember wetin Amalek do to you for di way as una come out of Egypt,
how e meet you for di way, and strike di hindmost of you, all wey dey feeble behind you, when you dey faint and weary. E no fear God.

Therefore e go be, when di Lord your God don give you rest from all your enemies round about, for di land wey di Lord your God dey give you for inheritance to possess am, say you go blot out di memory of Amalek from under heaven. You no go forget.”
“E go come be say, when you don come into di land wey di Lord your God dey give you for inheritance, and possess am, and dwell inside am,

say you go take of di first of all di fruit of di ground, wey you go bring in from your land wey di Lord your God dey give you, and you go put am for one basket, and go go to di place wey di Lord your God go choose, to cause im name to dwell dere.
You go come to di priest wey dey for dem days, and talk to am, ‘I declare today to di Lord your God say I don come to di land wey di Lord swear to our papa dem to give us.’
Di priest go take di basket out of your hand, and set am down before di altar of di Lord your God.
You go answer and talk before di Lord your God, ‘My papa dey one wandering Aramean. E go down into Egypt, and sojourn dere, few in number. E become dere one nation, great, mighty, and populous.
Di Egyptians mistreat us, and afflict us, and lay on us hard bondage.
When we cry to di Lord, di God of our papa dem, di Lord hear our voice, and see our affliction, and our toil, and our oppression.
Di Lord bring us out of Egypt with one mighty hand, and with one outstretched arm, and with great terror, and with signs, and with wonders.
E bring us into dis place, and give us dis land, one land wey dey flow with milk and honey.
Now look, I don bring di first of di fruit of di ground, wey you, Lord, don give me.’ You go set am down before di Lord your God, and worship before di Lord your God.
You go rejoice for all di good things wey di Lord your God don give to you, and to your house, you, and di Levite, and di stranger wey dey among you.

When you don finish tithing all di tithe of your increase for di third year, di year of tithing, and don give am to di Levite, to di stranger, to di orphan, and to di widow, so that dem go eat within your gates, and dey full,

you go talk before di Lord your God, ‘I don remove di holy things out of my house, and moreover I don give dem to di Levite, and to di stranger, to di orphan, and to di widow, according to all your commandment wey you don command me. I no transgress any of your commandments, neither don I forget dem.

I no eat of am for my mourning, neither remove any of am while I dey unclean, nor give any of am for di dead. I don listen to di voice of di Lord my God. I don do according to all wey you don command me.
Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and di ground wey you don give us, as you swear to our papa dem, one land wey dey flow with milk and honey.’
Dis day di Lord your God command you to do dem statutes and ordinances. You go therefore keep and do dem with all your heart and with all your soul.
You don declare di Lord dis day to be your God, and to waka for im ways, and to keep im statutes, and im commandments, and im ordinances, and to listen to im voice.
Di Lord don declare you dis day to be im people for im own possession, as e don promise you, and say you go keep all im commandments,
and to make you high above all nations wey e don make, for praise, and for name, and for honour, and so that you go be one holy people to di Lord your God, as e don speak.”
Moses and di elders of Israel command di people, talk, “Keep all di commandment wey I command you today.
E go be say for di day wey you go pass over di Jordan to di land wey di Lord your God dey give you, say you go set up for yourself great stones, and plaster dem with plaster.

You go write on dem all di words of dis law, when you pass over, so that you go go in to di land wey di Lord your God dey give you, one land wey dey flow with milk and honey, as di Lord, di God of your papa dem, don promise you.
E go be say, when una don pass over di Jordan, say una go set up dem stones, wey I command una today, for Mount Ebal, and you go plaster dem with plaster.
Dere you go build one altar to di Lord your God, one altar of stones. You no go lift up any iron tool on dem.
You go build di altar of di Lord your God of uncut stones, and you go offer burnt offerings on am to di Lord your God.
You go sacrifice peace offerings, and go eat dere, and go rejoice before di Lord your God.
You go write on di stones all di words of dis law very plainly.”
Moses and di Levitical priests speak to all Israel, talk, “Keep silence, and listen, Israel. Dis day you don become di people of di Lord your God.
You go therefore obey di voice of di Lord your God, and do im commandments and im statutes, wey I command you today.”
Moses command di people for di same day, talk,
“Dem go stand on Mount Gerizim to bless di people, when una don pass over di Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
Dem go stand on Mount Ebal for di curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
Di Levites go answer, and speak to all di men of Israel with one loud voice,
‘Cursed be di man wey make any carved or molten image, one abomination to di Lord, di work of di hands of one craftsman, and set am up for secret.’ All di people go answer say Amen.
‘Cursed be im wey dishonour im papa or im mama.’ All di people go say Amen.
‘Cursed be im wey remove im neighbour landmark.’ All di people go say Amen.
‘Cursed be im wey make di blind wander out of di way.’ All di people go say Amen.
‘Cursed be im wey pervert di justice due to di stranger, orphan, and widow.’ All di people go say Amen.
‘Cursed be im wey lie with im papa wife, because e don uncover im papa skirt.’ All di people go say Amen.
‘Cursed be im wey lie with any kind of animal.’ All di people go say Amen.
‘Cursed be im wey lie with im sister, di pikin woman of im papa, or di pikin woman of im mama.’ All di people go say Amen.
‘Cursed be im wey lie with im wife mama.’ All di people go say Amen.
‘Cursed be im wey strike im neighbour secretly.’ All di people go say Amen.
‘Cursed be im wey take one bribe to kill one innocent person.’ All di people go say Amen.
‘Cursed be im wey no uphold di words of dis law to do dem.’ All di people go say Amen.”
